name: paperless-ngx-mcp
description: MCP server for Paperless-ngx document management. Search, browse, and manage documents and metadata.

paperless_url.title: Paperless-ngx URL
paperless_url.description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance (e.g. http://localhost:8000)

paperless_token.title: Paperless-ngx API Token
paperless_token.description: API authentication token. Generate one in Paperless-ngx under Settings > Administration > Auth Tokens.

download_dir.title: Download Directory
download_dir.description: Optional directory for document downloads. When set, downloaded files are saved here with their real filenames and are not auto-cleaned. When unset, a temp directory is used.

policy_enabled.title: Policy filter
policy_enabled.description: Switch on the tag-based policy filter: documents outside the full tier expose metadata only, and the classification tags and fields can't be changed. Off by default.

policy_full_tags.title: Policy: full tags
policy_full_tags.description: Comma-separated tag names whose documents may expose text and files. Required when the policy filter is on.

policy_metadata_tags.title: Policy: metadata tags
policy_metadata_tags.description: Comma-separated tag names whose documents expose metadata only. Required when the policy filter is on.

policy_restricted_tags.title: Policy: restricted tags
policy_restricted_tags.description: Comma-separated tag names of documents that should never be visible to the API user (listed so they are protected).

policy_protected_tags.title: Policy: protected tags
policy_protected_tags.description: Further comma-separated tag names the agent may never add, remove, rename or delete, such as re-classification triggers.

policy_protected_custom_fields.title: Policy: protected custom fields
policy_protected_custom_fields.description: Comma-separated custom field names the agent may never set, change, remove, rename or delete.

tools.name: document_page_image
tools.description: Render a document page as a viewable image
